title: Scheduling commit times out after it was applied
description: The scheduling API applies the change but the response times out, so the gateway sees an ambiguous outcome.
callerVisible: Caller hears an honest status (being confirmed) and either a reconciled confirmation or a callback/human route; never an unverified success.
backendEvidence: Tool result UNKNOWN_OUTCOME with reconciliation reference
Reconciliation by idempotency key before any retry

registry.injectionPoint: the reference business API applies the change and times out the response

postconditions: The change is applied and the response times out: the tool result is UNKNOWN_OUTCOME with a reconciliation reference
Reconciliation by idempotency key happens before any retry or success announcement
